title: Introduction
text: This synthetic fixture section frames AI agent covert channels and describes agent covert-channel detection. It is synthetic fixture content, not real literature.

title: Evaluation
text: Evaluation section: communication trace monitor is tested on synthetic multi-agent transcript benchmark with covert-signal false alarm rate. The result is used only for offline GapForge evaluation.

title: Limitations
text: Limitations section: deployment shift and source coverage remain unresolved for agent covert-channel detection; adjacent network covert channels evidence is only partial.
